name: Atypical behavior
definition: Atypical behavior is an abnormality in a person's actions that can be controlled or modulated by the will of the individual. While abnormal behaviors can be difficult to control, they are distinct from other abnormal actions that cannot be affected by the individual's will.

name: Autism
definition: Autism is a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by impaired social interaction and communication, and by restricted and repetitive behavior. Autism begins in childhood. It is marked by the presence of markedly abnormal or impaired development in social interaction and communication and a markedly restricted repertoire of activity and interest. Manifestations of the disorder vary greatly depending on the developmental level and chronological age of the individual (DSM-IV).

name: Aggressive behavior
definition: Behavior or an act aimed at harming a person, animal, or physical property (e.g., acts of physical violence; shouting, swearing, and using harsh language; slashing someone's tires).

name: Compulsive behaviors
definition: Behavior that consists of repetitive acts, characterized by the feeling that one "has to" perform them, while being aware that these acts are not in line with one's overall goal.
obo_definition: Behavior that consists of repetitive acts, characterized by the feeling that one "has to" perform them, while being aware that these acts are not in line with one's overall goal.

name: Restrictive behavior
definition: Behavior characterized by an abnormal limitation to a few interests and activities.
obo_definition: Behavior characterized by an abnormal limitation to a few interests and activities.

name: Impaired ability to form peer relationships
definition: Difficulty to establish relations with others in a comparable social group (peers) that may be manifested in pehnomena such as not being able to initiative a conversation, understand social cues, or to discuss shared interests. This feature is associated with poor integration within a community or group.

name: Autistic behavior
definition: Persistent deficits in social interaction and communication and interaction as well as a markedly restricted repertoire of activity and interest as well as repetitive patterns of behavior.

name: Inflexible adherence to routines
definition: A need to strictly adhere to repetitive routines or patterns of behavior which are created by the environment. One becomes upset or distressed when their routines are disrupted or altered.

name: Motor stereotypy
definition: Use of the same abnormal action in response to certain triggers or at random. They may be used as a way to regulate one's internal state but must otherwise have no apparent functional purpose.

name: Inappropriate laughter
definition: Laughing that may be excessive and/or inappropriate in context (e.g., laughing at a funeral while others are crying).

name: Delayed speech and language development
definition: A degree of language development that is significantly below the norm for a child of a specified age.
obo_definition: A degree of language development that is significantly below the norm for a child of a specified age.

name: Hyperactivity
definition: Hyperactivity is a condition characterized by constant and unusually high levels of activity, even in situations where it is deemed inappropriate.
obo_definition: Hyperactivity is a condition characterized by constant and unusually high levels of activity, even in situations where it is deemed inappropriate.

name: Absent speech
definition: Complete lack of development of speech and language abilities.
obo_definition: Complete lack of development of speech and language abilities.

name: Lack of peer relationships
definition: The state of not having relationships with peers outside of school or organized activity appropriate to developmental level. This may be caused by behavioral or physical barriers.

name: Bruxism
definition: Bruxism is characterized by the grinding of the teeth including the clenching of the jaw and typically occur during sleep, but also can occur while the affected individual is awake.
obo_definition: Bruxism is characterized by the grinding of the teeth including the clenching of the jaw and typically occur during sleep.

name: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder
definition: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) manifests at age 2-3 years or by first grade at the latest. The main symptoms are distractibility, impulsivity, hyperactivity, and often trouble organizing tasks and projects, difficulty going to sleep, and social problems from being aggressive, loud, or impatient.

name: Pica
definition: An appetite for and the persistent ingestion of non-food substances such as clay. In order to diagnose pica, this behavior must have persisted over a period of at least one month.

name: Stereotypical hand wringing
definition: Habitual clasping and wringing of the hands in the middle of the body, similar to a hand-washing movement.

name: Stereotypical body rocking
definition: Habitual repetitive movement of the entire body, front to back or side to side.

name: Reduced social responsiveness
definition: A reduced ability to participate in the back-and-forth flow of social interaction appropriate to culture and developmental level, which is normally characterized by an influence of the behavior of one person on the behavior of another person. This results in difficulty interacting with others through emotional, physical, or verbal communication.

name: Auditory sensitivity
definition: Decreased tolerance to sound.
obo_definition: Decreased tolerance to sound.

name: Inappropriate crying
definition: Uncontrolled episodes of crying occur without any apparent motivating stimuli.
obo_definition: Uncontrolled episodes of crying occur without any apparent motivating stimuli.

name: Happy demeanor
definition: A conspicuously happy disposition, characterized by frequent smiling and laughing, which may be contextually inappropriate or unrelated to the situation.

name: Recurrent hand flapping
definition: A type of repetitive behavior in which the affected individual repeatedly waves the hands and/or arms rhythmically.

name: Tics
definition: Repeated, individually recognizable, intermittent movements or movement fragments that are almost always briefly suppressible and are usually associated with awareness of an urge to perform the movement.
obo_definition: Repeated, individually recognizable, intermittent movements or movement fragments that are almost always briefly suppressible and are usually associated with awareness of an urge to perform the movement.

name: Motor tics
definition: Movement-based tics affecting discrete muscle groups.
obo_definition: Movement-based tics affecting discrete muscle groups.

name: Tongue thrusting
definition: Pressing forward of the tongue in the mouth, a retained motoric habit from infantile swallowing patterns

name: Impulsivity
definition: Acting on the spur of the moment or on a momentary basis without consideration of outcomes; having difficulty establishing or following plans; experiencing a sense of urgency and engaging in behavior that is uninhibited, cannot be inhibited, and is uncontrolled. The possibility of repression is inconceivable.

name: Self-injurious behavior
definition: Self-aggression.

name: Stereotypic upper-extremity movements
definition: Abnormal movements of the upper extremities.
